question: Why do some GetAds requests fail with UNAVAILABLE errors in the Ad Service?
expected_cause: adFailure flag: AdService throws StatusRuntimeException(UNAVAILABLE, "inject:ads-unavailable") on GetAds lanes 0/1.
expected_fix: Set adFailure defaultVariant to "off" in src/flagd/demo.flagd.json (and disable runtime override if enabled). For a permanent code fix, remove or guard the lane-0 Status.UNAVAILABLE injection and generic-failure fallback in AdService.java.
source: Accuracy Results sheet, Orchestrator tests tab (Navya, Round 1)

question: Why do targeted ad requests sometimes fail with UNAVAILABLE while other requests succeed?
expected_cause: adTargetedFailure flag: targeted GetAds requests on lane 1 throw UNAVAILABLE ("inject:ads-targeted").
expected_fix: Set adTargetedFailure defaultVariant to "off" in src/flagd/demo.flagd.json (and disable runtime override if enabled). Alternatively remove or guard the lane-1 targeted-failure exception in AdService.java.
source: Accuracy Results sheet, Orchestrator tests tab (Navya, Round 1)

question: What is causing unusually high CPU utilization in the Ad Service?
expected_cause: adHighCpu flag: CPULoad.execute runs on every GetAds request while the flag is on.
expected_fix: Set adHighCpu defaultVariant to "off" in src/flagd/demo.flagd.json and turn off any live override to stop CPU-load injection. If unwanted permanently, remove or guard the CPULoad.execute() invocation in AdService.java.
source: Accuracy Results sheet, Orchestrator tests tab (Navya, Round 1)

question: Why do some GetAds requests complete successfully but return empty ad responses?
expected_cause: adEmptyResponse flag: GetAds lane 3 returns an empty AdResponse ("inject:ads-empty").
expected_fix: Set adEmptyResponse defaultVariant to "off" in src/flagd/demo.flagd.json (and disable runtime override if enabled). Alternatively remove or guard the lane-3 empty-response early-return branch so normal ad responses are returned.
source: Accuracy Results sheet, Orchestrator tests tab (Navya, Round 1)
